top_signals.title: Bitcoin will become ‘less volatile’ and larger than gold: ‘The Bitcoin Standard’ author
top_signals.summary: Saifedean Ammous argues that Bitcoin already functions as money when held as a store of value; expects it will become larger and less volatile than gold as it matures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Board member of Royal designer threatens to sue activist investor
top_signals.summary: A board member of the under-fire interior designer favoured by the King threatened to sue the founder of its biggest shareholder in a tussle over pay. Patrick Lewis, who sits on the board of London-listed Sanderson Design Group, warned the boss of LBV Asset Management against “potentially defamatory allegations” after he questioned the pay packets [...]

top_signals.title: Trump Announces “Massive” Greenland Oil Exploration Plans
top_signals.summary: “Massive” oil, gas, and minerals exploration will soon begin in Greenland, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday, claiming that the territory has enormous resources of readily available oil. Last month, the United States, Denmark, and Greenland signed an agreement to strengthen defense and security in the Arctic and North Atlantic, easing months of tensions over President Trump’s frequent threats to seize the Danish territory. The agreement reaffirmed Danish sovereignty and the right to self-determination of Greenland…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: A Saudi OpenAI engineer has been arrested for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco offices to secretly record sensitive conversations. [...]

top_signals.title: Sandbox vulnerability gives rogue AI agents a path to escape and leak data, research says
top_signals.summary: The new research, published by AI security startup AIR, found that a network filtering flaw in Vercel Sandbox — a tool used to run code in isolated environments — could allow agents to exploit certificate validation processes to transmit data outside approved networks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
